en.t: Black had already placed a stone.

units.source_text: 我远离棋盘，也不知道他下在什么地方。

en.t: I was away from the board and did not know where he had played.

units.source_text: 就算知道他下在什么地方，也不晓得他的用意何在。

en.t: Even if I had known where he had played, I would not have understood what he intended.

units.source_text: 他无缘无故地远离了酣战的中原，下在上边了。

en.t: For no apparent reason, he had moved far away from the fiercely contested center and played on the upper side.
